events.verdict: George (UTA) steps forward and firms up in his defensive position and the ensuing body contact with McCollum (NOP) is marginal.
George (UTA) legally contests Murphy III's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Filipowski (UTA) jumps to contest Williamson's (NOP) driving shot attempt and although he turns in mid-air, the body contact that occurs is marginal.
Olynyk (NOP) maintains a legal guarding position during George's (UTA) drive to the basket nd Missi (NOP) cleanly blocks the shot attempt.
Missi (NOP) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds after blocking the shot attempt.
Filipowski (UTA) reaches forwards, but begins retracting his arm as Olynyk (NOP) enters his shooting motion. Any arm contact that occurs on the play is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Martin (UTA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Martin does not beat Williamson (NOP) to the spot and he moves forwards into him, initiating body contact that causes him to lose control of the ball.
Martin (UTA) commits a take foul on Brown (NOP).
Murphy III (NOP) retreats away from George (UTA) during his jump shooting motion and avoids making any illegal contact.
Juzang (UTA) commits a take foul on Olynyk (NOP).
Utah requests a timeout when they do not have any remaining and are charged with an excessive timeout.
